name: Anyrow
tagline: AI document extraction with built-in structured storage Anyrow turns messy documents into live, editable tables
description: AI document extraction with built-in structured storage Anyrow turns messy documents into live, editable tables. Define a schema, upload PDFs, scanned invoices, receipts, purchase orders, or emails, and AI extracts matching rows directly into your table. Built-in OCR handles scanned and photographed documents automatically. How it works - Define your schema (fields + types) - Upload documents — PDF, image, email - AI populates matching rows in your live table - Query, edit, export, or pull via R
